text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We did it, Trainer!
It's first place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The roaring cheers at the finish line! They're so powerful... No matter how many times I hear them, my heart races! Hehe!
choice_data_list: Someday, let's earn the applause of the whole world!
It's too early to get carried away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...I won't be satisfied here.
The world is waiting for me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Though sown late,
I will make this seed bloom without fail—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right.
After all, our goal is the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"『L'école de la vie n'a
point de vacances』
Let's keep our feet firmly on the ground!"
